title: ELEC GEN 1 FAULT

trigger.comment: Gen off line is only a FAULT with the engine actually running — Gen1Line==0 alone is the normal state every ground minute before start, and fired falsely at the gate on the 2026-08-15 flight test (issue #58).

actions.say: Electrical, generator 1, off, then on. Attempt a reset.
actions.discrepancy: Generator 1 has not come back on line.

actions.say: If the fault persists, generator 1, off.

status: Status. Generator 1 lost; the associated bus tie is supplying the network.
Consider starting the A.P.U. and its generator to restore full electrical redundancy.
No immediate operational limitation; monitor the electrical page.
